claims: "Everything" by voidtools is a free file search engine for Windows.
"Everything" by voidtools instantly locates files and folders by name.
"Everything" by voidtools was initially released around 2008.
"Everything" by voidtools displays results in real-time as you type.
"Everything" by voidtools displays all files and folders on your computer immediately.
"Everything" by voidtools monitors USN Journals for real-time updates.
"Everything" by voidtools primarily focuses on filename searches.
"Everything" by voidtools offers a slower content search filter.
"Everything" by voidtools requires administrative privileges to access the NTFS change journal.
Everything (Game) is a 2017 procedurally driven simulation game.
In Everything (Game), every object in a vast, interconnected universe is playable.
